negativeOrNullFindings: PMID 37417725 - the transdermal microstructured system produced a 3.72 percentage-point smaller lumbar spine BMD gain than subcutaneous abaloparatide, with administration-site reactions in 94.4% of recipients.
PMIDs 37130601, 36592455 and 30907957 are independent network meta-analyses that place abaloparatide against every alternative - use these rather than sponsor comparisons.
cautions: Abaloparatide is a PTHrP analogue, teriparatide is a PTH fragment. They are not the same molecule class and their receptor conformational selectivity differs - do not describe them interchangeably.
ACTIVE and ACTIVExtend are one continuous programme; ATOM is the separate male study.
